name: Qwen3.8-27B abliterated
note_long: At medium the e-foil changes shape every run: two masts, a board sunk to the waterline, a wing above the surface. At extra-high effort it gets a clean single-mast foil flying over the water, after 29 minutes and 29,587 thinking tokens.

note.en: Medium: a different foil every run. Xhigh: correct, but 29 minutes.
note.ru: Medium: каждый раз другое крыло. Xhigh: правильно, но 29 минут.
